currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP)

language.description: BCP-47 language tag (e.g. en, fr, de)

premium.description: premium amount in the quote's native currency

deductible.description: deductible amount in the quote's native currency

effective_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the quote takes effect

product_line.description: voluntary-benefit product line the quote covers

carrier_product_name.description: the carrier's own product name, verbatim

plan_year.description: plan year the quote is for (e.g. 2027)

commission_basis.description: broker commission basis, verbatim (e.g. heaped, level)

commission_rate_pct.description: broker commission rate as a percentage, text as printed (e.g. 20)

rates.description: one row per premium rate printed in the quote

coverage_tier.description: who the rate covers: employee, employee + spouse, employee + children, family

tobacco.description: tobacco rating class (UNI = unismoker / not distinguished)

amount.description: the rate exactly as printed, in the quote's native currency; never computed

frequency.description: billing frequency the rate amount is expressed in, per row (carriers mix them)

rate_basis.description: FLAT premium, per $1,000 of benefit, or per unit of benefit

benefit_amount.description: benefit amount the rate is priced at, as printed

design.description: one row per benefit-design provision printed in the quote

category.description: the benefit provision, in standard terms where obvious (e.g. Heart Attack)

category_original.description: the carrier's own term for the provision, verbatim

value.description: the provision's value as printed (e.g. $10,000, 6 months, Yes)
